chapters.title: ASIA HIGH & LOW
chapters.text: Asia closes: ASIA HIGH 26029.00 and ASIA LOW 25858.75 are final. They carry forward as dotted lines until Asia opens again.

chapters.title: AT THE ASIA HIGH
chapters.text: The bar reaches up to the ASIA HIGH 26029.00 (within 2 ticks) and closes at 26020.25, still below it: no close through, so the level stands.

chapters.title: LONDON HIGH & LOW
chapters.text: London closes: LONDON HIGH 26028.50 and LONDON LOW 25921.75 are final. They carry forward as dotted lines until London opens again.

chapters.title: AT THE LONDON HIGH
chapters.text: The bar reaches up to the LONDON HIGH 26028.50 (within 2 ticks) and closes at 26017.00, still below it: no close through, so the level stands. The same line capped London at the ASIA HIGH.

chapters.title: LONDON LOW TAKEN
chapters.text: The first bar to reach the LONDON LOW 25921.75 closes at 25904.00, below it: the level is taken and the rest of its dotted line fades. A wick would not count; it takes a close.

chapters.title: ASIA LOW TAKEN
chapters.text: The first bar to reach the ASIA LOW 25858.75 closes at 25843.75, below it: the level is taken and the rest of its dotted line fades. A wick would not count; it takes a close.
